question.text: Which of the following statements is correct for a lyophilic sol?

options.text: The coagulation of this sol is irreversible in nature
It is quite stable in a solvent

solution.text: In lyophilic sols, the dispersed phase particles have great affinity for the dispersion medium. These sols are reversible. These are quite stable. Examples include gum, gelatin, starch, proteins and rubber etc.
